ORDER-005.expected: Product behavior is explicit; progress, pace, stock, and payroll remain mathematically consistent.

ORDER-005.vulnerable_or_broken_path: replace_shift_production_logs accepted positive meters for same-org orders without checking cumulative total_target_meters, order status, or the machine current_order_id assignment.
ORDER-005.fix_type: Migration/RPC/table-boundary hardening plus focused source tests.
ORDER-005.proof_needed_for_code_verified: Source proof that the active replacement RPC computes post-replacement totals before delete/insert and rejects totals greater than order total_target_meters while preserving Batch 2 generated-stock reconciliation.

ORDER-009.expected: Produced stock/history retained; no new logs accepted; loom unlinks.
ORDER-009.affected_workflow: Order cancellation followed by supervisor production logging or direct authenticated RPC submission.
ORDER-009.vulnerable_or_broken_path: Owner cancellation unlinked machines in app code, but replace_shift_production_logs only checked same-org order existence, so a direct authenticated RPC call could add production against a cancelled order.
ORDER-009.fix_type: Migration/RPC/table-boundary hardening plus focused source tests.
ORDER-009.proof_needed_for_code_verified: Source proof that order-attributed rows require orders.status = active, machines.status = active, and machines.current_order_id matching the submitted order, and that replacing existing order-attributed logs for non-active orders is blocked.
ORDER-009.future_qa_runtime_proof_required_for_pas: After migration application to QA, prove cancellation preserves existing production/stock history, unlinks the loom, and rejects new order-attributed logs through UI/server action and direct authenticated RPC/API probes.

PROD-011.vulnerable_or_broken_path: UI and server action rejected negative meters, but replace_shift_production_logs and production_logs table constraints did not enforce meters >= 0 at the authenticated RPC/database boundary.
PROD-011.fix_type: Migration/RPC/table-boundary hardening plus focused source tests.
PROD-011.proof_needed_for_code_verified: Source proof that production_logs has a forward-only nonnegative-meter CHECK for new writes and both the table trigger and replacement RPC reject meters < 0 before persistence.
PROD-011.future_qa_runtime_proof_required_for_pas: After migration application to QA, prove direct authenticated RPC/table API attempts with negative meters are rejected, impossible corrections cannot reduce produced meters below zero, and valid production/correction paths still reconcile generated stock.

SIGNOFF-02.fix_type: Dependency source fix only if ORDER-009 boundary proof is accepted; no separate runtime sign-off proof in this batch.

implementation_summary: Added a NOT VALID production_logs_meters_nonnegative CHECK constraint so new production writes cannot persist negative meters without rewriting existing history.

Added public.enforce_production_log_order_boundary as a BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger to block negative meters, non-active order-attributed writes/corrections, stale loom/order assignments, and over-target direct table writes.

Replaced replace_shift_production_logs with the Batch 2 stock-atomic body plus pre-delete guards for negative meters, active assigned order attribution, non-active order-attributed replacement blocking, and post-replacement over-target totals.
Preserved the existing duplicate detection, audit row, affected production grain tracking, and reconcile_generated_stock_for_production_grain call path.

review_adjustments.finding: Initial review found zero-meter order-attributed logs could still be submitted against cancelled/completed or stale-assigned orders.
review_adjustments.fix: The migration and Batch 22 test were tightened so any order-attributed log, not only positive production, requires an active order assigned to the active loom; unanchored downtime/status rows remain valid.

ORDER-005: replace_shift_production_logs builds submitted_order_totals and weavly_order_totals_after_replacement before deleting existing rows.
The table trigger also rejects ROUND(v_existing_total + NEW.meters, 2) greater than the active order target.
ORDER-009: replace_shift_production_logs requires order-attributed rows to join an active order and active machine where m.current_order_id matches the submitted order_id.
replace_shift_production_logs rejects replacement of existing order-attributed logs for non-active orders.
The table trigger applies the same active-order/current-loom assignment guard to direct production_logs writes.
PROD-011: production_logs_meters_nonnegative CHECK (meters >= 0) is added as NOT VALID for forward-only enforcement on new writes.
replace_shift_production_logs raises Production meters cannot be negative when any submitted row has meters < 0.
public.enforce_production_log_order_boundary raises Production meters cannot be negative before direct insert/update writes.
SIGNOFF-02: The ORDER-009 dependency is source-fixed by the active-order/current-assignment guard at the RPC and table boundary.
No pass-ready sign-off proof is claimed because current-run runtime proof is still required.
